summary: Accept selection and signed min/max leaves through the shared Pure32 mechanism after separate source/proof review, fresh replay, preserved repairs and distinguishing mutation checks.

examined.reason: Implemented exact frozen semantic contracts; source correspondence, all-input proof signatures, both typed frontends, 67 public declarations and negative checks independently reviewed.
Added only selp.b32/min.s32/max.s32, removed signed32 from uncovered siblings, pinned exact source/patch/replay/current definitions; nine-form count is not total ISA coverage.
Added exact-control probes for unsupported-name error classification and target floor; both mutants compile with standard-axiom proofs but fail unchanged acceptance.
Only unrelated new public audit registrations touch the linked audit file; existing message-passing proofs and model unchanged.
The manual section inventory remains unassessed; selected accepted forms are a separate child ledger and do not imply section coverage.
Both leaves exactly instantiate the reviewed total pure-operation interface, with no engine or target/operand-contract changes.
The parent already separates proof validity, source fidelity, raw evidence and assisted model evaluation; these two additional bounded trials preserve that contract.

results.method: Isolated exact snapshot: bash scripts/check.sh; fresh v2 worker replay; manual source/proof review; separate control/mutation checks; stratic validate
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0; dependency-free root package; Python standard library; isolated /tmp/ptx-leaves-isolated
results.evidence: Full root checks passed: 9 accepted forms, all evidence manifests, coverage regressions, 73 worker tests, 26 ledger tests, source/proof scans, full build and exact dependency audit of 862 declarations. Both new candidates passed fresh isolated replay and explicit source review; 67 public leaf declarations audited. Both deliberate mutations built and passed standard-axiom audit while unchanged acceptance drivers rejected intended defects. Original evaluator failures preserved; all final selected bytes unchanged after checks. Log /tmp/ptx-leaves-finalcheck.log; durable per-trial integration-check.log and archives.
